name: Spend Atlas
note: A squarified treemap written by hand drills from categories into merchants: each merchant tile grows out of its category's old rectangle by FLIP-ing only the tile background with the Web Animations API (labels translate, never scale), and every tile is a size container so its label adapts with cqi type. Six months of seeded card transactions drive the treemap, the stacked daily chart, the sortable merchant grid and the team matrix, so every figure ties out; set --dbf-spend-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Card Controls
note: Each card is drawn in CSS with a pointer-tracked 3D tilt and a specular highlight driven by @property angles; freezing sweeps a frost layer across it with clip-path while an @property-animated conic ring shows spend against the limit. Dragging the limit, flipping channel switches or locking a category re-runs the policy over the next 14 days of scheduled charges and shows which would decline; set --dbf-cards-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Budget vs Actual
note: A budget-to-actual bridge (a hand-built waterfall) sits over a treegrid of bullet charts laid on subgrid, whose department rows expand on grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr, with a highlighter swipe drawn by clip-path under every line more than 5% over plan. Month, shift-click range, quarter and YTD scopes recompute every figure from monthly line-item data; set --dbf-budget-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Receivables Ageing
note: Ageing is computed from each invoice's issue, due and paid dates as of the chosen month-end, so moving the as-of date genuinely re-buckets the ledger; the customer by bucket matrix, the stacked ageing strip and the invoice grid filter one another, and bulk actions use :has() to light the toolbar. Set --dbf-ar-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Treasury Positions
note: Switching the reporting currency re-converts every balance through one rate table, and each figure rolls to its new value on per-digit odometer columns staggered with a --i custom property and a linear() spring. A donut, entity bars and an FX shock slider all read the same positions, and the guilloche rosette turns on an @property angle that pauses off screen; set --dbf-treasury-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Fraud Review Queue
note: A keyboard-first triage queue (J/K to move, A approve, D decline, E escalate, U undo) where decided alerts collapse out with FLIP and the case pane explains the score as additive signal contributions; the score dial sweeps on an @property angle and the SLA clocks pause when the component is off screen. Set --dbf-fraud-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Payout Calendar
note: Captures settle on business-day lags per rail (card T+2, ACH T+3, wallet T+1, skipping weekends and holidays), and hovering a payout day draws SVG arcs back to the capture days that fund it; the selected day breaks its net payout down in a gross-to-net waterfall. Set --dbf-payouts-h to 100dvh in an app.
